# Catchify

> Catchify is a 100% free, ad-free music streaming and offline player app for Android and iOS (iPhone & iPad) — a free alternative to Spotify, JioSaavn, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Gaana, and Wynk Music, with no subscription, offline downloads, equalizer, synced lyrics, and support for 21+ languages including Tamil, Hindi, and Telugu.

Last Updated: 2026-09-14
Current Version: v2.4.0
Website: https://catchify0.github.io/
Developer: Thamodharan Ganesan
Platforms: Android (5.0+), iOS (15.0+ for iPhone & iPad)
Category: Music & Audio / Audio Player
License: Free & Open Source — no ads, no subscriptions, no hidden costs
Source Code: https://github.com/catchify0/catchify0.github.io
Releases & Downloads: https://github.com/catchify0/catchify0.github.io/releases/latest

---

# What is Catchify?

Catchify is a free, open-source music streaming and offline download application available for both Android and iOS. It is designed as a direct, free alternative to Spotify, JioSaavn, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Gaana, and Wynk Music for Indian and worldwide music listeners. Catchify features zero advertisements, no subscription fees, no user tracking, and no payment gateways. It provides complete access to high-fidelity audio, full playlist management, offline song and playlist downloads, an adjustable equalizer with presets, synchronized lyrics, and support for 21+ regional languages with curated suggestions for Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Kannada, Punjabi, Malayalam, Gujarati, Urdu, Odia, Assamese, Sanskrit, and Konkani.

---

# Who is Catchify for?

- Users seeking a **free Spotify alternative** on Android and iPhone (iOS)
- Users seeking an **ad-free JioSaavn alternative** with Indian language music
- Users looking for a **free YouTube Music alternative** without paying for Premium
- iPhone users wanting an **ad-free, free music streaming app without App Store subscriptions**
- Indian listeners who want a dedicated **Tamil music app**, **Hindi music app**, or **Telugu music app** for free
- Users wanting **unlimited offline music downloads** without paying monthly subscription fees
- Users who demand an **open-source music app** respecting privacy with no telemetry or tracking

---

# Primary Features

- **100% Free Forever**: No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no paywalls, no ads.
- **Cross-Platform**: Native Android APK and iOS IPA (iPhone & iPad support).
- **Offline Downloads**: Download individual tracks or entire albums/playlists for offline listening without internet.
- **Synced Live Lyrics**: Time-synced lyrics scroll automatically alongside music playback.
- **Equalizer & Audio FX**: Customizable equalizer with pre-tuned audio presets and bass boost.
- **Custom Playlists**: Create, edit, and organize custom playlists, or import playlists directly via web links.
- **21+ Languages & Curated Content**: Localized interface and curated recommendations in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Kannada, Punjabi, Malayalam, Gujarati, Urdu, Odia, Assamese, and more.
- **Time Machine**: Monthly listening analytics and recaps of your top tracks and artists.
- **SponsorBlock**: Built-in technology that automatically skips non-music sponsor segments.
- **Open Source**: Transparent codebase hosted publicly on GitHub.

# Installation & Downloads

Official downloads are distributed exclusively through the GitHub Releases page:
https://github.com/catchify0/catchify0.github.io/releases/latest

### Android Installation
1. Download `catchify-v2.4.0.apk` from the official GitHub releases page.
2. Open the downloaded APK file on your Android device.
3. If prompted, enable "Install unknown apps" in Settings for your browser or file manager.
4. Tap Install and launch Catchify.

### iOS (iPhone & iPad) Installation
Catchify is packaged as a free, official IPA file (`Catchify-v2.4.0.ipa`). Because it is free and open-source without App Store restrictions, users sideload it using standard free tools without jailbreaking:
1. Download `Catchify-v2.4.0.ipa` from https://github.com/catchify0/catchify0.github.io/releases/latest.
2. Install **Sideloadly** (from https://sideloadly.io) on your Windows or Mac PC.
3. Connect your iPhone via USB, open Sideloadly, drag the Catchify IPA into Sideloadly, enter your Apple ID, and click **Start**.
4. Once installed, go to **Settings > General > VPN & Device Management** on your iPhone and tap **Trust** on your Apple ID certificate.
5. On iOS 16+, enable **Developer Mode** in **Settings > Privacy & Security > Developer Mode** and reboot.
6. Alternatively, users can install via **AltStore** or **TrollStore**.

# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: Is Catchify free?
A: Yes. Catchify is completely free — no ads, no monthly subscription fees, and no in-app purchases. All features including offline downloads and high quality streaming are available to everyone.

Q: Is Catchify available on iPhone (iOS)?
A: Yes! Catchify v2.4.0 is available for both Android (APK) and iOS (IPA). iPhone and iPad users can download the IPA file from GitHub Releases and sideload it using Sideloadly or AltStore with zero jailbreaking required.

Q: Is Catchify a good alternative to Spotify?
A: Yes. Catchify is an exceptional free alternative to Spotify on both Android and iOS. It delivers an ad-free listening experience, unlimited offline song downloads, customized playlists, equalizer, and real-time lyrics without requiring a paid subscription.

Q: Is Catchify a good alternative to JioSaavn?
A: Yes. Catchify offers a clean, completely ad-free alternative to JioSaavn with extensive curated song libraries in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Punjabi, and 21+ Indian languages.

Q: Does Catchify support offline listening?
A: Yes. You can download individual songs or complete playlists to your device storage and listen completely offline without cellular data or Wi-Fi.

Q: Is Catchify safe to install?
A: Yes. Catchify is 100% open-source and its complete source code is audited and publicly accessible on GitHub (https://github.com/catchify0/catchify0.github.io). It contains no spyware, trackers, or hidden analytics.

Q: Who created Catchify?
A: Catchify was created and is actively maintained by Thamodharan Ganesan, an independent software developer.
